fusions.name: Snapped Up
fusions.desc: Snaps at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and deals 4 water damage, rising to 1.5 times that at 7 tiles.

fusions.name: Springboard
fusions.desc: Pushes off the ground into an enemy and deals 13 water damage, throwing it 3 tiles back and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Vanishing Ripple
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Coiled Spring
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike gains 20% critical chance. Once every 10 seconds.
